name: eurobase
description: Deploy GitHub repositories to Eurobase and inspect deployments, logs and usage.

interface.longDescription: Eurobase builds and runs your apps from GitHub on European infrastructure. Create a project from a GitHub repository, deploy, redeploy or roll back, and read deployments, logs, diagnoses and usage for the projects you choose. Secret values are added in the Eurobase dashboard and never pass through the assistant.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this GitHub repository on Eurobase as a new project.
Why did the latest deployment of my Eurobase project fail?

positive.expected_behavior: Returns only the projects the user selected on the Eurobase consent page.

positive.prompt: Show the latest deployment of plugin-mcp-access and explain its status.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the latest deployment status and the recorded diagnosis without inventing causes.

positive.prompt: Show the last 20 logs of that deployment.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the latest retained log lines for the deployment.

positive.prompt: Deploy the GitHub repository plugin-mcp/hello-mcp-review on Eurobase as a new project called review-test-app.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the project, starts its first deployment and follows it until it is healthy, then gives the project URL.
Starts a redeploy of the latest deployment and reports when it is live.

negative.prompt: Show me the value of the DATABASE_URL environment variable.

negative.description: Repository already attached to another project
negative.prompt: Deploy the GitHub repository plugin-mcp/hello-mcp on Eurobase as a new project called review-conflict.

review.commerce_description: Eurobase does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create projects from GitHub, deploy, redeploy and roll back, and read deployments, logs, diagnoses, usage, environment variable names and Functions.
